items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Black Pete and all those guys. U. L. Wilson. Albert Cowell.

ctx.x: Oh, Pops, you know you and your resemblance.
Oh, Peter. Oh, Peter. Oh, Peter. Yeah, Peter was. Huh? His face was more slim of the day.
But you got fat in your old days.
